sources.title: DIGITIMES Research: Notebook Tracker – Nov 2022
sources.locator: Page 4, “Top-3 notebook ODMs,” paragraph beginning “Inventec’s notebook shipments slipped 14%...”
sources.note: States Inventec’s notebook shipments declined year over year as “HP, its largest client,” cut more than 60% of its orders. This supports the dated client ranking, not an undated or continuing ranking.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Focused searches found direct, time-scoped support for November 2022, but did not establish whether the ranking held during the original claim’s unspecified reference period.
The evidence is industry research, not an Inventec filing or disclosure.
The source supports a November 2022 ranking only. It provides no quantified customer share and does not establish the ranking for the unspecified reference period of the original claim.
